description: Elements of the model as plain data, filtered and paged. Kinds: level, wall (start/end points, length along the centre line, bulge and radius for curved walls, height, thickness, face area m², opening ids), slab, roof, stair, door, window (width, height, sill, host wall id, size limits), furniture (type, position, rotation, size, limits), room (area m², enclosed, tag), column, beam (start/end, width, depth, top), ramp (start = foot, end = top, rise, gradient), lift (position, shaft size, height, stops), parking (aisle start/end, count, accessible, bay size, angle), grid (origin, rotation, spacings, labels; not on a level), model (an imported IFC storey, SketchUp/glTF/OBJ model, or a group: source, file, position, rotation, bounds, part count, IFC classes; its parts with list_model_parts). Outlines are summarised unless detail is "full". Every element has id, kind, name, level (the level's id) and properties (custom data).

property.description: Only elements with this custom property (set to this value)

selected.description: Only what the user has selected
